# Jesse Battle IV

> Fourth-generation St. Petersburg, Florida native. Certified General Contractor
> (Florida license CGC1506583, held since 2003) and licensed Florida real estate
> sales associate with Team Kym Coyle at Charles Rutenberg Realty. Owner of
> Pinellas Builders. Thirty years of construction experience applied to buying
> and selling residential property in Pinellas County.

## About

- [Home](https://jessebattle.com/): Background, credentials, and contact.

## Areas of expertise

- Pinellas County and St. Petersburg residential real estate
- Waterfront and low-lying property evaluation
- FEMA flood zones, elevation certificates, base flood elevation
- Florida floodplain ordinance and substantial improvement thresholds
- Permit and county record history research
- Residential construction systems, structure, and realistic repair cost
- Relocation, waterfront, and luxury property in St. Petersburg

## Writing

- [Writing index](https://jessebattle.com/blog/): Commentary on the Pinellas County
  residential market, flood and insurance considerations for Florida coastal
  property, and renovation trends as they affect residential property value.
